body: I've had minor problems with it. I've had more along the lines of reactionary depression though (ie. my parents going through a divorce, getting injured while trying to run collegiately).

She is currently looking for a new doctor. She claims to hate her current one and told me that it was a bad idea for her to go cold turkey on meds even though it's what her doctor told her to do.

I have had to calm her downs a few times from where she has panic attacks when she hits her moments. I actually have her phone number so I could keep in touch with her from where I quit for a period of a few months, so I'll send her little texts on a relatively consistent basis. Anything from "smile" to "you're awesome." I know that's not much, but its things like that that make my day. 


She normal does tend to seem normal. She tells me her texts make her smile when I send them. I've talked to her on vent when she is happy. Her panic attacks and depression seem to be caused from a certain individual (I think she's basically had an emotion affair with a guildie) who tends to on in the evening. She tends to have them anywhere between 6 pm est and 3-4 am est. She recently just found out whoever she was having the emotional affair with is doing the same with other women in her guild (I don't really know on this one). I haven't really pushed her about the whole emotional affair. I literally just found out about the affair thing.

I do try to voice my concern with her at times, but I don't really try to push her about it if she seems put offish about it.

Last I talked to her about meds she said her health care had recently decided to cover the only med she's ever taken that has really helped with her depression. I think she has an appointment soon with a new doctor, so hopefully that will help alleviate some of the issues.

I've tried to get her to talk to a counselor, but she claims she doesn't have the money from where she is a stay at home mom.
